legacy_note_doc_cut.text: the reader stopped early — some of the document's text may be missing

legacy_note_ppt_cut.text: the reader stopped early — some of the presentation's text may be missing

legacy_note_xls_chart_text.text: the workbook holds text from its charts (chart titles, series and trendline names, and axis titles), which is not extracted

legacy_note_xls_cut.text: the workbook was cut short — later sheets or cells may be missing

note_page_text_lost.text: the text of {pages} could not be read ({count} of {total} pages)

note_page_text_partial.text: the text of {pages} could not be read in full ({count} of {total} pages)

note_pdf_annotations_truncated.text: only the first {max} annotations were read

note_pdf_fields_truncated.text: only the first {max} form fields were read

note_pdf_options_truncated.text: only the first {max} options of a form field were listed

note_skipped_unsupported.text: in a format this pipeline cannot convert

note_slide_comments_unreadable.text: slide {n} comments could not be read

note_slide_notes_unreadable.text: slide {n} notes could not be read

note_slide_rels_unreadable.text: slide {n} relationships could not be read

note_xlsx_cells_lost.text: {count} cell(s) left out: the shared string table does not provide their text

note_xlsx_columns_late.text: sheet "{name}": {count} column definition(s) left out: the sheet writes them after its data, where they reach no cell of it

note_xlsx_columns_lost.text: sheet "{name}": {count} column definition(s) left out: the columns they hide or style are not ones this reader can place

note_xlsx_columns_partial.text: sheet "{name}": {count} column definition(s) cover a range whose end this reader cannot place, so only the column each one starts at is hidden or styled

note_xlsx_comment_authors_lost.text: sheet "{name}": {count} comment author(s) could not be resolved

note_xlsx_comments_lost.text: sheet "{name}": {count} comment(s) left out: the cell they name is not one this reader can resolve

note_xlsx_comments_unreadable.text: sheet "{name}": its comments could not be read

note_xlsx_links_lost.text: sheet "{name}": {count} link(s) left out: the target or the cell range it names is not one this reader can resolve

note_xlsx_marks_dropped.text: sheet "{name}": later merged ranges and links left out: the sheet declares more of them than this reader marks

note_xlsx_merges_lost.text: sheet "{name}": {count} merged range(s) left out: the cell range they name is not one this reader can mark

note_xlsx_sheet_rels_unreadable.text: sheet "{name}": its relationships could not be read

note_xlsx_threaded_comments_unreadable.text: sheet "{name}": its threaded comments could not be read

pdf_note_fields_unreadable.text: the document has a form, but its fields could not be read

pdf_note_no_fillable_fields.text: the document has a form, but no field that can be filled

render_unreadable.text: the file could not be read

render_not_pdf.text: its bytes do not form a PDF this engine can read

render_no_such_page.text: it has no such page (it has {pages})

render_failed.text: the page could not be rendered

render_invalid_size.text: the requested page size is not a positive, finite number

reason_not_carried_out.text: the {operation} operation is not carried out

reason_old_office_version.text: an old Office version this tool cannot read

xlsx_note_cut.text: the workbook part is cut short, so the sheets and names it declares after that point are not read

xlsx_note_rels.text: the workbook's relationships could not be read, so its parts are read by their conventional names and one named only there may be missed, leaving its cells showing the value as stored

xlsx_note_styles.text: the workbook's cell formats could not be read, so values are shown as stored

edit_no_content_types.text: cannot edit {name}: it has no [Content_Types].xml part

edit_no_family_part.text: cannot edit {name}: it holds no document, workbook or presentation part, so it is not a .{family} package

edit_signature_note.text: [the input carries a digital signature, which was carried through unchanged — the file changed, so the signature no longer matches it]

edit_work_over_budget.text: the edits rewrite about {megabytes} MB of the document's parts, more than one call applies (limit {limit_megabytes} MB) — hint: split the edits into several calls

edit_list_too_many.text: a call may carry at most {max} edits, got: {count}

edit_sheet_repeat_address.text: {address} would be stated twice in the sheet part — two elements claiming one address is a part a reader offers to repair, so this edit was refused rather than written

edit_write_failed.text: the edited package could not be written: {message}

write_leftover.text: the call failed ({message}) and what it had already written could not be removed: {files}

edit_element_unclosed.text: {what} holds <{name}> opened and never closed, so a second <{name}> cannot be written beside it

edit_part_duplicate.text: the package states the part {name} twice

edit_chart_note.text: [the workbook's charts were copied unchanged — nothing recomputes them, so a chart that reads the changed cells keeps the values it had]

edit_pivot_note.text: [the workbook's pivot tables were copied unchanged — nothing recomputes them, so a pivot that reads the changed cells keeps the values it had]

edit_styles_root.text: the workbook's styles part cannot be written into: its <styleSheet> root is missing or never closed

edit_styles_no_root_to_write.text: there is no <styleSheet> root to write a <{name}> block into

edit_styles_no_entry_element.text: STYLE_BLOCKS states no entry element for the {block} block

edit_styles_no_relationship.text: cannot edit {name}: the workbook's relationships cannot name a styles part, so the formatting would sit in a part no reader reads

edit_number_format_too_long.text: a number format must be at most {max} characters, got: {length}

edit_relationships_unreadable.text: the relationships of {part} are not readable

edit_content_types_no_close.text: [Content_Types].xml has no <Types> close to hold a part's content type

edit_sheet_name_text.text: {where}: a sheet name must be text, got: {value}

edit_sheet_name_length.text: {where}: a sheet name must be 1 to {max} characters, got: {name}

edit_sheet_name_forbidden.text: {where}: a sheet name must not contain any of {forbidden}, got: {name}

edit_sheet_missing.text: there is no sheet named {name}: this workbook has {sheets}

edit_sheet_is_chart.text: the sheet {name} is a chart sheet, and this tool edits worksheets only

edit_sheet_not_worksheet.text: the sheet {name} is not a worksheet, and this tool edits worksheets only

edit_sheet_part_missing.text: the sheet {name} names the part {part}, which the package does not have

edit_sheet_no_part.text: the sheet {name} has no worksheet part: the workbook's relationships do not name one and the package has no {part}

edit_sheet_exists.text: a sheet named {name} already exists — hint: pick a name no sheet uses, ignoring case

edit_address_shape.text: {what} must be an A1 address like B7, got: {value}

edit_address_row.text: {what} {value}: the row must be between 1 and {max}

edit_address_column.text: {what} {value}: the column must be between A and {last}

edit_row_number.text: row must be a whole number between 1 and {max}, got: {value}

edit_column_letters.text: column must be column letters between A and {last}, got: {value}

edit_value_kind.text: {what} must be text, a number or a boolean

edit_formula_shape.text: cell {reference}: an object value must be {"formula": "SUM(A1:A2)"}

edit_set_cell_no_value.text: set_cell needs a value — hint: use the format_cells op to change only a cell's formatting

edit_cell_not_in_sheet.text: the cell {cell} is not in sheet {sheet}

edit_sheet_no_rows_insert.text: sheet {sheet} has no rows to insert into

edit_row_past_range.text: row {row} is past the sheet's used range (1-{max})

edit_sheet_last_row.text: sheet {sheet} reaches the last row ({max}), so an insert would push a row past the sheet's grid

edit_sheet_no_columns_insert.text: sheet {sheet} has no columns to insert into

edit_column_past_range.text: column {column} is past the sheet's used range (A-{last})

edit_sheet_last_column.text: sheet {sheet} reaches the last column ({last}), so an insert would push a column past the sheet's grid

edit_stale_note.text: [the shift left {kinds} pointing at the old cells — they were not rewritten]

edit_shift_range_gone.text: [the deleted {kind} covered the whole {what}, {range}, which is gone with it]

edit_kind_rule_formulas.text: the sheets' conditional-format and data-validation formulas

edit_kind_other_sheets.text: the other sheets' formulas naming this sheet

edit_rows_unclosed.text: the sheet part holds a <row> opened and never closed, so its rows cannot be read

edit_cells_unclosed.text: the sheet part holds a <c> opened and never closed, so its cells cannot be read

edit_rows_not_ordered.text: {where} are not in address order and one of them states no address of its own, so reordering them would move what it holds

edit_sheet_rows_outside.text: the sheet part states a <row> outside its <sheetData>, or a second <sheetData>: a worksheet holds its rows in one body, which this tool does not edit around

edit_worksheet_order.text: <{name}> has no place in this kit's worksheet order, so nothing was written

edit_worksheet_no_close.text: the sheet part has no </worksheet> to write a <{name}> into

edit_format_target_missing.text: a format_cells edit needs one of range, column or row

edit_format_target_many.text: a format_cells edit names more than one target ({targets}), but takes exactly one

edit_range_shape.text: range must be an A1 address or an A1:B2 range, got: {range}

edit_range_cap.text: the range {label} covers {cells} cells, more than the {max} one format may name

edit_merge_one_cell.text: the range {label} covers one cell, and a merge needs at least two — hint: name a range like A1:B2

edit_border_object.text: border must be an object naming sides ({sides}), got: {value}

edit_border_empty.text: border must name at least one side ({sides})

edit_border_side.text: border has no side {side} — hint: use {sides}

edit_border_boolean.text: border.{side} must be true or false

edit_font_too_long.text: font must be at most {max} characters, got: {length}

edit_color_digits.text: color must be {digits} hex digits, with an optional leading "#", got: {value}

edit_wrap_boolean.text: wrap must be true or false

edit_format_no_property.text: a format_cells range target names no property — hint: name at least one of font, size, bold, italic, underline, strike, color, fill, border, align, vertical, wrap or number_format

edit_format_no_width.text: a format_cells column target names no width_chars — hint: name width_chars

edit_format_no_height.text: a format_cells row target names no height_points — hint: name height_points

edit_merge_unclosed_block.text: the sheet part holds <mergeCells> opened and never closed, so its merges cannot be read

edit_merge_unclosed_cell.text: the sheet part holds a <mergeCell> opened and never closed, so its merges cannot be read

edit_merge_already.text: sheet {sheet} already has {label} merged — hint: unmerge {ref} first, or name a range that is not merged

edit_merge_overlaps.text: the range {label} overlaps {ref}, which sheet {sheet} already has merged — hint: unmerge {ref} first

edit_merge_unreadable.text: sheet {sheet} holds a merge this kit cannot read, so a merge into it was refused rather than written over it

edit_unmerge_not_merge.text: the range {label} is not a merge in sheet {sheet}: it has {refs}

edit_sheet_list_missing.text: the workbook has no sheet list to add a sheet to

edit_only_sheet.text: sheet {sheet} is the workbook's only sheet, and a workbook keeps at least one

edit_only_visible_sheet.text: sheet {sheet} is the workbook's only visible sheet, and a workbook keeps at least one

edit_scoped_names_gone.text: [the workbook's sheet-scoped names for {sheet} went with the sheet]

edit_sheet_gone.text: [the sheet {sheet} is gone, but {kinds} still name it — those references were not rewritten]

edit_sheet_renamed.text: [the sheet {sheet} is now {next}, but {kinds} still name {sheet} — those references were not rewritten]

edit_move_no_position.text: no position {to}: this workbook has {count} sheet{s}

edit_move_same_position.text: sheet {sheet} is already at position {to} — moving it there would change nothing

edit_move_no_close.text: the workbook's sheet list has no close to place the moved sheet before

edit_image_extension.text: only PNG, JPEG or WebP images can be embedded, got: {name}

edit_image_unreadable.text: cannot read {name} — the file is not readable

edit_image_not_whole.text: cannot embed {name} as a {label} image: the file's bytes are not a whole {label} image

edit_image_side_span.text: an image's width and height must be {bounds} points, got: {side}

edit_image_implied_span.text: an image's {side} implied by its {other} must be {bounds} points, got: {points}

edit_image_no_drawing.text: sheet {sheet} names a drawing part this kit cannot find, so the picture was not added

edit_drawing_no_close.text: the drawing part {part} has no </xdr:wsDr> to place a picture in

edit_wrong_family.text: the {noun} is really a .{family} package, not the .{expected} one its name says — hint: {hint}

edit_formula_note.text: [the sheet's {count} {phrase} while {moved} moved — check the references]

edit_formula_phrase_one.text: formula was left as it is

edit_formula_phrase_many.text: formulas were left as they are

edit_format_widened_one.text: those cells are one merged cell

edit_format_widened_many.text: those cells are covered by {count} merged cells

surface_destination_symlink.text: the destination {directory} is a symlink: document output needs a real directory

surface_destination_not_directory.text: the destination {directory} is not a directory

surface_destination_missing.text: the destination directory {directory} does not exist

surface_destination_unreadable.text: the destination directory {directory} could not be read

surface_reserved_output.text: the request carries "{name}": the destination names the outputs

surface_groups_missing.text: the pdf_split operation needs a "groups" array

surface_groups_empty.text: the pdf_split operation needs at least one group

surface_groups_too_many.text: the pdf_split operation takes at most {max} groups

surface_inputs_missing.text: the pdf_merge operation needs "inputs" to be a list of file paths

surface_merge_inputs_too_many.text: the pdf_merge operation takes at most {max} inputs

surface_merge_bytes_too_many.text: the pdf_merge inputs hold {megabytes} MB together, more than one call loads (limit {limit_megabytes} MB)

pdf_page_unreadable_file.text: cannot read {name} — the file is not readable

pdf_page_unparseable.text: cannot read {name} as a PDF — its bytes do not form a PDF this tool can read

pdf_page_encrypted.text: {name} is password-protected — the tool cannot open an encrypted PDF

pdf_page_no_page.text: no page {page}: this document has {count} page(s)

pdf_page_count_limit.text: the request names {count} pages, more than one call takes (limit {limit})

pdf_page_degrees.text: "degrees" must be a multiple of {step}, got: {degrees}

pdf_page_area_shape.text: "area" must be an object of x, y, width and height, as fractions of the page

pdf_page_area_side.text: "area.{side}" must be {bounds} of the page, got: {value}

pdf_page_area_inside.text: "area" must lie inside the page and be non-degenerate: its x and y must leave room for its width and height, and both must be positive

pdf_page_no_area_crop.text: page {page} has no visible area to crop

pdf_page_no_area_resize.text: page {page} has no visible area to resize

pdf_page_side.text: "{side}" must be {bounds} points, and a resize names both sides, got: {value}

pdf_page_stuck.text: [{total} annotation(s) could not follow the resized content on {pages}]

pdf_page_write_failed.text: the produced PDF could not be written: {message}

pdf_page_tree_nested.text: the page tree nests deeper than this engine walks (limit {max})

pdf_page_object_nested.text: an object the page reaches nests deeper than this engine copies (limit {max})

edit_docx_edited_text.text: the body's own text, a text box's and a table cell's included

edit_docx_edited_block.text: the body's own paragraphs, a table cell's included

edit_docx_addressed_text.text: a text box's own text and a table cell's are addressed, a field's cached result is not

edit_docx_addressed_block.text: a table cell's own text is addressed, a text box's or a field's cached result is not

edit_docx_find_across.text: the text {find} is not in the document's body: the fragment reaches across a paragraph boundary, and an edit addresses one paragraph at a time

edit_docx_find_indent.text: the text {find} is not in the document's body: the fragment's leading whitespace is either the indentation the reader prints under a block or whitespace the file's text does not hold — search for {trimmed}

edit_docx_find_peripheral.text: the text {find} is in {parts} of this document, which a docx edit does not change — it edits {edited}, and not that part

edit_docx_find_peripheral_revised.text: the text {find} is not in the document's body: it is text a tracked revision holds in {parts} of this document, which the reading prints as revised rather than as live text, and an edit addresses the text the body's runs hold today

edit_docx_find_contents.text: the text {find} is in this document's table of contents, which an edit does not change — its entries and their page numbers are the table's own field result, and an edit addresses {edited}

edit_docx_find_revised.text: the text {find} is not in the document's body: it is text a tracked revision holds, which the reading prints as revised rather than as live text, and an edit addresses the text the body's runs hold today

edit_docx_find_label.text: the text {find} is not in the document's body: {mark} is a label the reader prints, not text in the file

edit_docx_find_break.text: the text {find} is not in the document's body: {reason}

edit_docx_find_absent.text: the text {find} is not in the document's body, its headers, its footers, its footnotes, its endnotes or its comments — {addressed}

edit_break_reason.text: the fragment holds a tab or a line break, and the file keeps it as markup of its own ({markup}) or as a paragraph of its own ({paragraph}), not as text — name a fragment on one side of it

edit_docx_bridged.text: the text {find} reaches across a {markup} in the file: a {markup} is markup of its own, not text an edit addresses, so writing across it would leave it with nothing to belong to — name a fragment on one side of it

edit_docx_container_last.text: removing every paragraph holding {find} would leave a {container} with no paragraph — a {container} must keep one

edit_docx_section_break.text: the paragraph holding {find} ends a section, and removing it would delete the section break — remove its text instead, with remove_text

edit_docx_page_break.text: the paragraph holding {find} holds a page break, and removing it would delete the page break — remove its text instead, with remove_text

edit_docx_listed_heading.text: the text {find} is in a heading this document's table of contents lists — an edit cannot rewrite the table's own entries, so changing the heading would leave the table disagreeing with it; leave that heading as it is, and have a document this tool creates write the table from the headings you want

edit_docx_nested.text: the document holds {depth} paragraphs open at once, and the engine walks at most {max}

edit_docx_no_property.text: format_paragraph needs at least one of align, style, indent_left, indent_right, indent_first_line, spacing_before, spacing_after, line_spacing or list

edit_docx_level_without_list.text: level needs a list to belong to — name "list" as {values} beside it

edit_docx_list_value.text: list must be {values}, or false to take the paragraph's list away, got: {value}

edit_docx_level.text: level must be a whole number from 0 to {max}, got: {value}

edit_docx_format_no_property.text: format_text needs at least one of bold, italic, underline, strike, size or color

edit_docx_row_shape.text: every table row must be a list of cells

edit_docx_table_empty.text: a table needs at least one row or one heading

edit_docx_table_columns.text: a table may hold at most {max} columns, got: {count}

edit_docx_style_not_paragraph.text: {name} is the document's {kind} style, and paragraph formatting needs a paragraph style

edit_docx_no_styles.text: the document defines no paragraph styles, so {name} cannot be resolved — hint: a built-in name such as Normal or Heading 1 always works

edit_docx_no_style.text: the document defines no paragraph style named {name} — it defines {names} — hint: a built-in name such as Normal or Heading 1 always works

edit_docx_numbering_root.text: the document's numbering part cannot be written into: its <w:numbering> root is missing or never closed

edit_docx_run_unclosed.text: a run holds <w:rPr> opened and never closed, so its properties cannot be read

edit_docx_ppr_unclosed.text: the paragraph holds <w:pPr> opened and never closed, so its properties cannot be read

edit_docx_no_body_anchor.text: the document has no body, so there is nothing to place an {op} after

edit_docx_no_body.text: the document has no body to add a paragraph to

edit_docx_anchor_text_box.text: the text {after} is inside a text box: an {op} after anchors in the document's own paragraphs (a table cell's counts), and a text box's paragraph is a nested one

note_docx_replacement_formatting.text: [the replaced text spanned several differently formatted runs — it took the formatting of the first one]

note_docx_heading_unlisted.text: [the paragraph is a heading this document's table of contents does not list]

note_docx_added_heading.text: [the paragraph added after a heading is a heading of its own, and this document's table of contents does not list it]

note_docx_added_section.text: [the paragraph the new one follows ends a section, so the new one does not carry its section break]

note_docx_matched_paragraphs.text: [the fragment matched {count} paragraphs — every one was formatted]

note_docx_matched_times.text: [the fragment matched {count} times — every one was formatted]

note_docx_partial_run.text: [the fragment covers only part of a run, and a run is the smallest unit formatting is stated on — the rest of that run's text took the formatting too]

note_docx_reached.text: [the edit also reached {kinds}, which the call did not name]

note_docx_tracked_on.text: [the document has tracked changes turned on, and what this call changed is written as plain content, not as a recorded revision]

note_box_past_edge.text: [the {what}'s box reaches past {where} — the part beyond {where}'s edge is not shown on it]
